evidence_scope.generation_constraint: Generation receives exactly one source_reference image and a self-contained textual style specification.

observations: All five references use polished editorial anime illustration rather than photography or 3D.
Opaque bounded color planes and concise cel-style light/shadow groupings recur.
Fine localized rendering and precise dark focal definition sit over a designed print field.
medium_rendering.transferable_rule: Render source-controlled content as a polished editorial anime poster with crisp opaque cel-shaded planes, focused fine detail, and print-like separation.
prompt_clauses: polished editorial anime poster illustration
crisp opaque two-to-three-step cel-shaded planes with focused fine detail
screen-print-like color separation and precise dark-ink focal definition

observations: Warm off-white paper and deep navy/near-black/deep-teal anchors recur.
Coordinated teal/cyan, coral/magenta, yellow/orange, and restrained ochre/gold accents recur, but sample 04 uses a visibly more muted variant.
Contrast is largely adjacent opaque value masses, not photographic gradients.
palette_tone.transferable_rule: Use a limited warm-paper print relationship with a deep dark anchor and a coordinated small accent set, while preserving source literal colors and translating only relative tonal treatment.
prompt_clauses: limited warm-paper poster-print relationship with deep-navy or deep-teal anchors and coordinated teal/cyan, coral/magenta, yellow/orange, and restrained ochre/gold accents
preserve source literal color identity and translate only relative value grouping, cel shadows, highlights, contours, and print-facet behavior

observed_relative_behavior.value: luminous clear local plane with a restrained darker shadow band
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: moderate warm source-relative treatment against stronger graphic supports
observed_relative_behavior.shading: bounded cel shadow with small controlled highlights
observed_relative_behavior.outline: selective fine dark containment rather than a heavy continuous outline

skin.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Keep the source person's skin identity unchanged; map only its existing light, shadow, highlight, and contour relationships to coherent graphic cel planes.
prompt_clauses: render visible skin as source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and small highlight planes with selective fine deep-navy containment
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: coherent mass with separated but limited interior value planes
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: source-relative dark/cool/warm accents rather than a fixed hue
observed_relative_behavior.shading: cel-grouped shadows with a few tapered highlight or strand accents

hair.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve the source hair's literal color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity; group its existing values and add only restrained relative accent planes.
prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accents and tapered deep-navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: fold-led interlocking light, dark, and accent facets
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: limited harmonized accents layered over the garment's own color identity
observed_relative_behavior.shading: bounded planes following construction and folds
observed_relative_behavior.outline: dark seam and edge anchors with selective fine trim

clothing.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Keep every source garment silhouette, construction detail, marking, logo, and literal color identity; add only restrained fold-following print facets, seam anchoring, and subtle grain.
prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain its silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accents, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos

observations: Variable-weight deep navy or near-black contours recur in all references.
Fine tapered arcs, connectors, dots, rules, and loose edge extensions recur.
Cropped discs, blocks, wedges, halftone fields, and brush sweeps are recurring adaptable vocabulary.
line_shape.transferable_rule: Use decisive variable dark ink and sparse tapered detail with adaptable abstract poster support forms, never copied teacher geometry.
prompt_clauses: decisive variable-weight deep-navy ink contours resolving into sparse tapered fine strokes
adaptable abstract discs, blocks, wedges, rules, halftone fields, brush sweeps, arcs, dots, and connectors without copied geometry

observations: A warm paper ground remains visible in every reference.
Restrained screen-print grain, speckles, broken overprint edges, halftone/stipple, and dry-brush interruptions recur with varying density.
texture_material.transferable_rule: Add selective tactile poster-print material that preserves source legibility and does not replicate literal print defects or mark paths.
prompt_clauses: visible warm paper grain with restrained screen-print speckling, occasional halftone or stipple, imperfect overprint edges, sparse paint flecks, and selective dry-brush interruptions
keep texture away from important source details and legible markings

observations: All references use asymmetric editorial hierarchy: paper field, opaque support fields, focal content, then fine line/dot/brush or halftone ornament.
Readable display lettering appears repeatedly but its wording, language, amount, orientation, and placement vary.
Negative space is actively designed but no exact layout recurs across all five images.
graphic_language.transferable_rule: Use adaptable asymmetric poster hierarchy and negative-space rhythm around source-controlled content. Apply typography only to caller-supplied exact text.
prompt_clauses: place broad opaque abstract support fields behind or around source-controlled content, then add restrained fine line, dot, halftone, or brush ornament
retain adaptable asymmetric negative-space rhythm without copying layout or placement

typography_dialogue.activation: Only when optional text is supplied; otherwise render no text or pseudo-text.
typography_dialogue.lettering_or_dialogue_container_medium: Readable editorial display ink integrated into the poster-print surface; no required dialogue container.
typography_dialogue.stroke: Elegant high-contrast calligraphic/display-like primary stroke with crisp edges and restrained fine line accompaniment.
typography_dialogue.hierarchy: Caller-supplied exact text is the only lettering content and is one restrained display accent; no invented subtitle, list, duplicate, or pseudo-word.
typography_dialogue.orientation: Adapt for readability; do not inherit a teacher angle or direction.
typography_dialogue.placement_grammar: Use unused negative space or an abstract support field without covering important source content and without copying teacher placement.
typography_dialogue.ornament: Sparse fine dot, orbital-line, or brush ornament may frame supplied text without forming letters or words.
prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text once as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
use readable high-contrast editorial display ink with elegant calligraphic/display-like strokes, adaptive orientation, open-space placement, and sparse non-lettering dot/line ornament
when text is absent, render no text or pseudo-text
do not copy teacher wording, script, language, logo, or text placement
